title: Observe native input dispatch before the automatic compatibility comparison
admission: Investigate the concrete EXP-210 baseline UIKit input inconsistency; no release-gate closure or SDK repair is pre-authorized by a diagnostic outcome.
hypothesis: Assigned native touch targets, event dispatch and existing valueChanged callbacks can locate a missing switch effect before interpreting RUM output. Fixed SDK-on/off arms may show an association, but prior SDK-on variability prevents a causal interference claim from one pair.

environment.device_policy: Create one fresh task-owned simulator after verifying exact runtime; remove it after both cells or a stopped attempt. No reused device/session identifier.

fixed_sequence: Fresh clean installation and unique run identity
Launch UIKit stack with existing default view/action predicates when SDK-on
Assert foreground Home, receipt0 and visible/hittable switch value0 before input
Existing home.tap button.tap() then its original 1.2-second capture window and native receipt1 within15seconds
Record pre-input switch frame/value and perform the existing home.toggle toggle.tap() exactly once
Freeze value transition and callback/receipt outcome within15seconds, before any later interaction
Flush the bounded event buffer at the post-input boundary; capture native records and perform scoped termination/uninstall cleanup
allowed_changes: Fresh isolated archive of the seven existing baseline source/private/resource roots; no SDK bytes changed
Isolated fixture copy: public UIApplication subclass and explicit UIApplicationMain entry, bounded in-memory pre/post sendEvent observations; call super exactly once
Isolated Observation.swift copy: runtime SDK-on/off initialization flag and a post-input diagnostic flush; preserve native callbacks, default predicates, RUM mappers and geometry
Fresh bounded XCTest collector retaining the exact initial tap/toggle inputs, existing preconditions and15second bounds; freeze failure before flush or later input
Fresh host runner/oracle and negative controls; exact source/build/installed identities and bounded cleanup
Owning result, experiment index, gate evidence, assessment, safety review, runbook and restart updates
forbidden_changes: SDK implementation, public APIs, existing accepted fixture/runner source, repository build scripts or dependencies
Control/window hierarchy or layout changes, UISwitch subclassing, extra hitTest calls, synchronous file writes in sendEvent
Programmatic switch actions, input retries or successful-only outcome selection
Duo pose, SwiftUI or physical-device cells; Session Replay captured-content work
Pushing, opening remote PRs, merging or publishing
decisive_oracle: Complete run-bound receipt/native/event inventories with monotonic sequences and exact selected test identifier
Button positive control: one assigned touch target resolving to home.tap, one native callback, receipt1

Switch observation: assigned touch ancestry plus before/after state and exactly one original callback for a successful value0to1 transition before the recorded result boundary; failed input remains a diagnostic failure
SDK-off produces no RUM rows; SDK-on mapper rows are context only, with no required switch RUM action
Reject stale/restored run IDs, buffer overflow/missing phases, missing/duplicate callbacks, late callbacks, source/binary/runtime drift and cleanup failure
No closure of the full compatibility matrix from this pair
stop_rules: Require independent source/oracle admission before native execution
Always retain both fixed arms unless source/environment/build/collector/cleanup integrity fails; an observed missing switch effect is a retained outcome, not permission to retry
Stop on infrastructure timeout, unexpected native crash or integrity failure; preserve partials and clean task artifacts
Both arms passing leaves original intermittent failure unresolved; do not fabricate root cause or launch more cells
Record only the observed dispatch/callback boundary and independently review any follow-up before changing input or SDK behavior

outcome.unexecuted_cell: sdk-off; stopped on observer/oracle mismatch as defined
outcome.result_limit: Successful native effect does not satisfy the stricter dispatch witness. No SDK-on/off comparison, causal finding or acceptance pass. Historical variability remains unresolved.

next: Keep original oracle rejection and all EXP210 failures. Do not run SDK-off or repeat this pair. Define a separate callback-side witness before any future dispatch diagnosis; continue independent release preparation meanwhile.
